in_arabic.name: Golchehr
in_arabic.long_meaning: Golchehr هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Persian word 'Gol' meaning moon and 'Chehr' meaning face, representing a radiant and shining moon. This name is often given to boys in the Islamic world, symbolizing enlightenment and guidance.
